target_customer: Health-optimizing consumers such as biohackers and lifters who track wearables, blood panels and genomics
problem: People's wearable, bloodwork and genomic data live in separate apps, so patterns are missed and users do not know what to change. Illume fuses the data and texts personalized insights.
business_model: Consumer subscription (inferred); currently private beta with free early access
product_category: AI personal health and longevity companion delivered by text

founders.name: Pari Latawa
education: MIT, BS and MEng in CS and biology
previous_startups: EasyComm (tools for children with Down syndrome)
founders.background_notes: Prior employers are research affiliations per YC page.

founders.name: Frank Lee
education: MIT, BS in computer science and mathematics

founders.name: Jin Wong
founders.background_notes: Named in the YC launch post but not in the YC page's active founders list.

competitors.name: Ultrahuman Blood Vision
competitors.what: AI blood-testing platform tied to wearable data
competitors.traction_then: US launch, 120+ markers at $800 per year

competitors.name: Death Clock Life Lab
competitors.what: AI health concierge combining blood work with a longevity plan

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating wearable, lab and genomic data sources and producing safe, useful insights by text is standard LLM and data engineering with privacy and health-claim care.

defensibility.rationale: Wearable makers and lab companies are adding AI companions, so copying is easy; a data aggregation layer is thin without proprietary data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Wearable and lab players were launching AI features in 2025 and 2026; no outcome for Illume yet.

market_need_then: Rising consumer interest in longevity and wearables, with products like Whoop Advanced Labs and Ultrahuman Blood Vision drawing users in 2025 and 2026. Illume's own traction was a Product Hunt launch with 87 upvotes on 2026-07-27 and a private beta.

branding.domain_note: Uses illumelabs.ai, a Labs suffix on a .ai domain

identity.visual_style: Minimal; site title reads 'Illume: A new lens on longevity'
identity.voice_and_tone: Concise and confident per the site title; little copy was available

branding.brand_signature: Texting your health companion, with a launch alias Taro mentioned in one source
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch, 87 upvotes, number 22 on the daily leaderboard

brand_strength.rationale: Early and thinly documented. The name Illume is shared with an unrelated Cincinnati wellness company, which creates confusion risk.

outcome_analysis: Illume Labs is a three-person Summer 2026 team of MIT graduates with health research and Windsurf experience, now in private beta after a July 2026 Product Hunt launch. No verified funding, exit or distress was found. The main risk is wearable and longevity incumbents shipping AI companions, so the outcome is too early to call.
notes: Aggregators disagree: Dealroom lists a $125k seed and Boston; CB Insights lists a $500K convertible note with YC as investor and San Francisco.
